title: Experimental dataset on Microstructured cellulose acetate biointerfaces regulate mesenchymal stem cell response and promote osteogenic commitment
question: How do surface preparation and local topography relate to AFM mechanical response?

measurement_dates: Some source measurements dated August 2023; release April 2026.
variables_and_units: AFM topography, mechanical maps and roughness
independent_units: surface preparation and independent scan region
validation_design: surface preparation and independent scan region Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Native SPM/TXT files, images and derived maps for flat, low-roughness and high-roughness cellulose acetate.
prior_analysis_and_limits: Group samples and scan regions, not pixels. Cellular-response measurements from the associated article are absent; this case supports surface mechanics only.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.
